repos.name: customer_app_2.0
repos.description: Customer mobile app (React Native) — primary frontend

repos.name: t2s-api
repos.description: Primary API service — Lumen/PHP, main backend for the customer app
repos.notes: Uses $router->get/post pattern. Routes in app/Http/v*/routes.php (versioned by date).

repos.name: t2s-mcs
repos.description: Microservices layer — provides API endpoints for the customer app

repos.name: falcon
repos.description: Falcon — AWS CDK TypeScript, Lambda-backed API Gateway. Routes defined via addResource/addMethod CDK constructs.
repos.notes: Serverless architecture. Routes are CDK constructs, not Express routes. Scanner targets addResource/addMethod patterns.

repos.name: falcon-payment-service
repos.description: Payment microservice — handles all payment flows

repos.name: foodhubglobal
repos.description: Standalone monolith — both frontend and backend in same repo. NOT connected to any other repo.
repos.notes: This repo is completely independent. Do not assume any API integration with t2s-api, falcon, or the customer app.
